build.title: AshesUI: live UI inspector for any app (hover tooltip + inspector window)

said.text: Framework library framework/libs/ashes (ai.amberx.axf.ashes) any web app installs. Context-menu toggle AshesUI with a check mark; while on, a small headless tooltip follows the pointer with live info about the element under it (component, asset, plugin it belongs to, size, colours, contrast, tokens). Double-click / double-tap expands into a draggable, resizable floating inspector window: tree of every rendered element on screen (selection in focus and expanded), and a tab group (Grid / Tree) with every parameter of the picked element; live style edits with revert; search, filters, copy, stats. Installed in the console with a plugin resolver (which plugin an element belongs to).

steps.text: Pure core: component/asset map, owner resolution, contrast, parameter rows, tree search
DOM snapshot + live listener + tooltip + highlight overlay
Inspector window: element tree with focus + expand, Grid/Tree tabs
Live edits, copy, stats, filters, keyboard navigation, settings
Context-menu check marks in MenuList; console install with plugin resolver
Tests, checks, catalog entry, docs, PR
